environment.description: Same application deployed as a pod in EKS cluster (v1.28) in namespace 'legacy-workloads'. Calico CNI v3.26.1 with GlobalNetworkPolicy enforcement. A namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy 'deny-metadata-egress' is applied with spec.podSelector matching label app=config-monolith, spec.policyTypes=['Egress'], with egress rules allowing DNS (UDP 53 to kube-dns) and TCP to config-service.internal on port 8080, but NO rule permitting traffic to 169.254.169.254/32 on any port. Calico's iptables-based dataplane inserts DENY rules in the pod's network namespace cgroup before any ALLOW, meaning the implicit deny-all-else on egress blocks the link-local metadata range. Additionally, the node's iptables nat chain has a DNAT rule for pod-originated traffic to 169.254.169.254 that redirects to a black-hole (DROP target) as defense-in-depth, configured via a DaemonSet running 'metadata-guard' which reconciles the iptable rule every 30s.
